assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry was performed with CPT 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
SilverBridge Advantage requires non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
Prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The denial is reflected in the CO-197 denial code
